XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Role Management — audit log of capability changes + role assignments

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_roles_auditlog
TABLE.COMMENT: Append-only audit trail of role + capability mutations made through the airpay_roles UI. Persists role shortname denormalized so log survives role deletion.

FIELD.NAME: roleid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_role.id at time of change. May refer to a deleted role.

FIELD.NAME: roleshortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of role.shortname at time of change. Survives role deletion.

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: capability_set | capability_unset | role_assigned | role_unassigned | role_created | role_deleted

FIELD.NAME: capability
FIELD.COMMENT: Capability name (e.g. moodle/site:config). Null for assignment events.

FIELD.NAME: oldpermission
FIELD.COMMENT: CAP_INHERIT(0) | CAP_ALLOW(1) | CAP_PREVENT(-1) | CAP_PROHIBIT(-1000). Null for non-cap events.

FIELD.NAME: newpermission
FIELD.COMMENT: As above. Null for non-cap events.

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_context.id where the change applied

FIELD.NAME: targetuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: For assignment events: the userid being assigned/unassigned

FIELD.NAME: changedby
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id of the admin who made the change

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional admin-supplied justification for the change (compliance trail)

FIELD.NAME: open_path
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant path of the changedby user at time of change. Empty for siteadmins on root tenant.

INDEX.NAME: idx_capability
INDEX.COMMENT: Compliance lookup: who changed this specific cap?
